features.name: REAPER keyboard ownership while ReaBeat window closed (pump gated)
features.assumption: macOS cannot reproduce the original Windows accelerator-bypass symptom; the spec guards the invariant 'REAPER receives keys while the window is hidden', which the ungated pump put at risk.

features.name: Stretch marker srcpos is SOURCE-ABSOLUTE on trimmed items (C1 fix)
features.evidence: src/ReaperActions.cpp insertStretchMarkers (no + takeOffset, v2.0.3); detection reads source file from 0 (BeatDetector::detectFile)
features.oracle: state (GetTakeStretchMarker srcpos vs synthetic click grid), mutation-verified (+D_STARTOFFS shift must turn red)

features.name: Tempo map markers restricted to the item range (constant mode)
features.assumption: Only constant mode is drivable without opening a SWELL combo dropdown; variable modes untestable via UI (see F8).

features.name: Detection GUID guard: result never attaches to a different item
features.oracle: state (item B untouched: 0 markers, playrate 1.0; A's cache restores and applies without re-detect)

features.name: Model download corruption handling (.part + Content-Length)
features.reason: Would need a controlled HTTP endpoint + a way to kill the download mid-flight inside the isolated instance; the model is already cached in ~/.reabeat so the download path never runs here. Candidate for a future seam (env override of the download URL).

features.name: Time signature dropdown override (6/8 etc.)
features.reason: JUCE ComboBox popup is its own transient window; item selection via synthesized input is not reliably targetable (no stable coordinates). Downbeat recomputation is internal state with no REAPER-side readback until Apply. Needs a gated test seam or visual goldens.

features.name: Tempo map variable modes / quantize modes / strength slider
features.reason: Same SWELL/JUCE dropdown limitation as F7. Constant mode covered by F4; Straight quantize is the default and is what F3 exercises.

features.name: UI scale 100-200% (setTransform)
features.reason: Trigger lives in a popup menu (title click) - menu item coordinates are OS-drawn and version-dependent. Would need visual goldens + menu automation; deferred.
